# `state/resonance/Transforms.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/resonance/Transforms.js`

state/resonance/Transforms.js — Phase 3 transforms.  Walsh/Hadamard  tiny binary patterns (3x3, 4x4)   [new] DCT-II          small visual blocks (8x8, 16x16)  Scale routing (per the plan): Walsh for tiny binary, DCT for small visual, wavelets for 32x32+/3D (added later). These produce the "resonance vector": a compressed signature of what a pattern RESEMBLES — never its identity.

## Functions

### `walshHadamard(input)`

In-place-style fast WHT. Integer input → integer output. Length must be a power of two. WHT(WHT(v)) === n * v (involutive up to the length scale).

**Parameters:**

- `input` *(ArrayLike<number>)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

### `pattern3x3ToVector(id)`

Map a packed 3x3 pattern to a length-16 bipolar vector ({0,1} → {-1,+1}, zero-padded to the next power of two) ready for the WHT.

### `dct1D(input)`

1-D DCT-II (orthonormal).

### `idct1D(input)`

1-D inverse DCT-II (orthonormal).

### `dct2D(block, N)`

2-D DCT-II of an NxN block (row-major Float array of length N*N).

### `idct2D(block, N)`

2-D inverse DCT-II.

### `quantize(vec, q = 1)`

Quantize a coefficient vector to integers by step `q` (lossy resonance).
